reading_rule: Each variant changes one declared scientific choice at a time. The canonical reference remains primary; no variant is selected by sign, magnitude, p-value, or gate outcome.

variants.description: Require at least two resolved GeoGCDF commitment projects in an ADM2-period rather than any resolved project.
Trim the first and last canonical treatment periods, retaining 2005-2006 through 2011-2012.
Use the native ACLED Violence against civilians event count instead of fatalities while keeping geography, timing, treatment, estimator, and gates unchanged.
